display.purpose: Run number on the stub only. Condensed gate lettering, tabular numerals.

display-figure.purpose: Backlog count or load percent in each target segment. Condensed, tabular.

headline.purpose: Product name in the ink top bar, uppercase.

title-segment.purpose: Target names on the pass segments, uppercase.

title-panel.purpose: Panel heads (Gate board, Proof, Cutover, Timeline...), uppercase.

title-stage.purpose: Route stop names on the pass, uppercase.

body.purpose: Explanations, empty states and notices; 62-72ch measure.

body-sm.purpose: Captions, stage notes, readiness details; the 14px floor for mechanic-carrying text.

status.purpose: Outlined state tags, always with an icon.

label.purpose: Field labels, column headers, setup labels and the NOW tag; 13.5px is the condensed-caps floor.

data.purpose: Every non-hero figure: facts, LSNs, rows, rates, timings. Tabular.

data-sm.purpose: Inline percents, log times, chip figures, worker toggles.

shadows.name: focus-keyline
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow: an ink keyline behind the 2px alert-yellow focus outline (offset 2px). Not elevation; the system is flat.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition and the gate-board rerank.

motion.name: rerank
motion.purpose: Gate-board rows move in place when their rank changes (failed, running by progress, pending, landed newest first).

motion.name: held-change
motion.purpose: A changed row, segment or panel holds the alert colour plus a NOW tag for 8s. The first data arrival is not a change.

motion.name: wash-fade
motion.purpose: Background colour transition on lit rows, segments and panels.

motion.name: stage-fill
motion.purpose: Route stop background when the current stage moves.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Square pulse on the live-source chip; a hard blink, not a glow.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Running-state loader icon in status tags.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses every animation and transition.

breakpoints.name: work-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Below: work area stacks; side column becomes two columns.

breakpoints.name: lower-two
breakpoints.purpose: Below: lower row becomes two columns with Timeline spanning both.

breakpoints.name: single

narrative.northStar: The Boarding Pass and the Gate Board
narrative.overview:
The migration run is a printed boarding pass: a dark slate stub carrying the run number and its facts, torn off along a punched perforation from a white pass that shows the six-stage route and one tear-off segment per target. Under it, the jobs are a live departure gate board: rows of table × target that rerank in place as they run and land. The system borrows the vernacular of travel ephemera (ink header bar, condensed gate lettering, die-cut notches, punched hole columns) and refuses the category default of a grid of equal stat cards on a grey admin ground.

Density is high and deliberate: an operator's screen, read as a still frame in a compressed 1080p recording. Everything is flat paper on a cool grey ground, held together by square corners and 1.5px ink rules. Colour is almost entirely absent; one alert yellow announces "changed just now / act now", and green and red appear only where a check passed or failed. The signature motion is a gate change: a row reranks, and whatever changed holds yellow with a NOW tag for eight seconds.

The system is light-only (`color-scheme: light`); the ink top bar and slate stub are the only dark surfaces and are part of the document, not a theme.
keyCharacteristics: Boarding pass + gate board, not stat cards.
Ink, slate, steel and white do all the structural work; yellow is a signal, never decoration.
Square corners, 1.5px ink rules, perforations and punched holes instead of shadows.
Condensed caps for every label and name, mono tabular figures for data, condensed display figures for the hero numbers.
Every state reads as a still image: unknown, stale, running, held-change, failed and ready.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Yellow means exactly one thing: changed just now, or act now. It never decorates, never fills a chart series, never marks a brand moment beyond the mark itself. At most one yellow primary button is on screen, and none after a cutover completes.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Green Rule
rules.body: Green and red carry pass/in-sync and fail meaning only. The live-source chip is white and the producer "streaming" state is ink, so green never means "active" or "live".

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every coloured state is paired with a word and, in tags, an icon (check, cross, clock, dashed circle, spinner, pause).

rules.name: The Two Figure Voices Rule
rules.body: The two hero figures (run number, segment backlog/percent) are set in Barlow Condensed 700 with tabular numerals, matching the gate lettering. Every other number (table cells, LSNs, timings, rates, counts) is JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals. Never set a hero figure in mono or a table figure in the condensed face.

rules.name: The Video Floor Rule
rules.body: Anything that carries a mechanic (a state, a figure, an instruction) is at least 14px; condensed caps labels are at least 13.5px. The surface is judged from a compressed 1080p recording.

rules.name: The Printed Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float. If something needs emphasis it gets the alert wash or an ink rule, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Punched-Hole Exception
rules.body: `radial-gradient` is used only to draw perforation and punch holes (3–3.5px dots in strong hairline); it is never used as a colour fade.

dos: Do reserve alert yellow (#ffd400) for the current stage, the single primary action, the NOW tag, the lit row's status cell and the frozen-source chip.
Do hold a change for 8 seconds with the alert wash (#ffe680) plus a NOW tag, and treat the first data arrival as an arrival, not a change.
Do rerank gate-board rows in place with a 450ms ease-out layout move; fade washes over 700ms.
Do set the run number and segment hero figures in Barlow Condensed 700 with tabular numerals, and every other figure in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do frame every document with a 1.5px ink rule on square corners, and separate pass parts with perforations, die-cut notches and punched hole columns.
Do pair every status colour with a word and an icon.
Do keep mechanic-carrying text at 14px or larger and condensed caps labels at 13.5px or larger.
Do show unknown and stale states honestly: dashes and "Source unknown" when nothing is known, last data plus a stale notice when the API drops later, and disabled controls in both.
donts: Don't use green for "live", "active" or "streaming"; the live chip is white and streaming is ink.
Don't add shadows, rounded corners or colour gradients; the only gradient is the punched-hole dot pattern.
Don't light more than one primary action, or any after a cutover has completed.
Don't build the surface from a grid of equal stat cards.
Don't use steel lighter than #5d636b for secondary text on white or the panel ground.
Don't add motion beyond the reranking, the held highlight, meter/timeline fills, the live pulse and running spinners; all of it collapses under reduced motion.
